title: MintMyMoment
tagline: Transforms memorable digital experiences into dynamic NFTs, which evolve and engage over time based on real-world interactions.
description: Mint My Moment transforms memorable digital experiences into dynamic NFTs, which evolve and engage over time based on real-world interactions. These unique, tradeable assets can be personalized and are securely recorded on the blockchain. Owners and creators benefit from transparent transactions and potential royalties on various NFT marketplaces.
how_its_made: "Mint My Moment" is built using Next.Js with TypeScript for a dynamic and responsive frontend. It integrates Supabase for efficient storage and database management, leveraging Supabase Storage to handle user-uploaded images securely. StarkNet, a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, is used for blockchain interactions, enabling high throughput and low-cost NFT transactions. Smart contracts written in Cairo manage the minting and evolving of dynamic NFTs. This setup allows seamless integration of Web3 technologies, providing engaging and interactive NFT experiences across sectors like coffee shops, real estate, and art.
